description: Repository-specific file-size limits consumed by scripts/check_file_size_limits.py. Rules are ordered: first match wins.

rules.name: github-ai-markdown
rules.rationale: AI customization and BKM files should stay compact enough to be loaded selectively without becoming parallel manuals.

rules.name: github-ai-json
rules.rationale: AI governance JSON should remain reviewable and should not hide large policy bodies.

rules.name: docs-markdown
rules.rationale: Architecture and planning documents can be longer than AI guidance files, but should remain bounded enough for review gates to inspect them explicitly.

rules.name: python-test
rules.rationale: Test files may group business scenarios and fixtures, but should split above this point.

rules.name: python-source
rules.rationale: Production Python modules should remain small enough to preserve module boundaries and readability.

exemptions.name: generated-or-cache-output
exemptions.reason: Generated or local runtime artifacts are not source files for review gates.

exemption_principles: Prefer splitting source files over adding exemptions.
Only exempt generated, cache, runtime, or external artifact files.
Any source-code exemption must name an owner, a reason, and a follow-up split plan.
